how_marie_works.heading: How Marie Works
paragraphs:
Every project begins with a conversation about the space, the atmosphere you wish to create, and the story your home might tell.
After receiving photographs and the dimensions of the wall or environment in question, Marie meets with you - either in person or online - to explore ideas, inspiration, and possibilities.

From this initial exchange, she develops a bespoke mood board of imagery, colour palettes, and visual references that capture the character of the space and the vision discussed. At this stage, you will also receive an initial project estimate.

Once the artistic direction has been established, Marie prepares a concept sketch or colour study, allowing you to see how the artwork will live within the architecture of the room before painting begins.

The design is then thoughtfully refined in close collaboration until every element feels beautifully balanced and perfectly at home within the space. A project timeline is agreed, and the creative journey begins.

The painting stage is where the transformation truly comes to life. Clients are welcome to be as involved as they wish, watching the artwork gradually unfold. Marie works exclusively with carefully selected, high-quality water-based paints - including emulsion, acrylic, mineral, and chalk finishes - chosen for their beautiful finish, fast drying times, and low odour, ensuring the space remains comfortable throughout the process.

Depending on the project, designs are painted directly onto walls or created on bespoke panels in Marie's studio before being installed on site. Every commission is a unique collaboration, resulting in an artwork that is entirely personal and impossible to replicate.
Ready to transform your space? Marie would love to hear your ideas and begin creating something truly extraordinary together.

process.heading: Process
process.intro: Each project is developed individually and typically includes:
steps:
Discovery -
A conversation to explore the space, the client's vision, and the atmosphere they wish to create.

Concept Design - 
Marie develops a bespoke artistic concept together with a detailed project proposal with a cost estimate.

Refinement - 
The design evolves through a creative dialogue until every element feels perfectly at home within the space.

Creation - 
The artwork is brought to life either on-site as a hand-painted mural or in the studio as painted panels or canvas, depending on the project.
